game_title: Guess Until Right – Underground River Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the shadow ranger ahead. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the rope bridge by solving code steps involving guess_range that move the shadow ranger forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the rope bridge first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Underground River'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Underground River.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
